name: Nandi Nkosi
bio:
Nandi Nkosi's journey into motorsport security was unconventional, beginning with a background in forensic accounting and cybersecurity before transitioning into high-stakes asset protection. Her early career involved unraveling complex fraud schemes, skills she now applies to mitigating risks within the fast-paced world of Formula 1. Nandi's meticulous attention to detail and proactive approach quickly earned her recognition, leading to her current role as Security Chief at Alpine F1. 

At Alpine, Nandi oversees all aspects of security, from physical asset protection to digital threat mitigation, ensuring the team's competitive edge remains shielded from external threats. She is committed to fostering a security-conscious culture within the team, empowering every member to be an active participant in protecting vital information and equipment. Nandi's demanding nature stems from her unwavering dedication to maintaining the highest security standards, making her an invaluable asset to the team's operational integrity.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly cropped natural hair with subtle auburn highlights
physical.description: Nandi has a strong, athletic build and a focused gaze that commands respect.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen for jotting down observations.
Has a habit of tapping her pen against her teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on conducting random security audits at unexpected times.
